messages.content: Hi — weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you doing this week? Go ahead and share any readings or anything on your mind whenever you're ready.
bp was 168/104 this morning. had a pretty bad headache all day yesterday too, figured it was sinus stuff but not sure

Thank you for that. I've logged the reading. A 168/104 combined with a headache is something a nurse needs to review, so I've flagged this for clinical follow-up right now — median response time is currently 31 hours. A nurse will reach out to you directly. Anything else you'd like me to pass along to them?
yeah actually I'm almost out of lisinopril. maybe 3 days left. can you send in a refill for me?

Refills aren't something I'm able to do — you'd need to contact your pharmacy or prescriber directly for that. I have made a note so the nurse is aware of it when they reach out. Your next regular check-in is scheduled for next week.
ok. honestly a little worried about that number. feels higher than usual
That's understandable. The nurse will be in touch. If your headache comes back or you feel worse before they reach you, please call your care team or 911. Talk soon.

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
